Haan, sahi hai: bada tukda aadha cake hai; teeno chhote milkar baaki aadha, toh har chhota tukda 1/4 se chhota hai. Ab ek cheez ki jagah bahut saari cheezein lenge, jaise laddoo, aam ya kanche, aur unka fraction nikalenge. Niyam wahi rahega: sab barabar. Yeh 12 laddoo hain, aur do bachche inhe barabar baantenge. Aadha matlab: dono bachchon ke paas ek jitne laddoo hon, aur ek bachche ke laddoo hi aadha hain. Jaanch bhi aasaan hai: dono bachchon ke laddoo jodo, toh saare 12 wapas. Yahan tak saaf hai?
